messages:
Carla P - EdgeCo: Hey team — EdgeCo ready to kick off the channel co-sell pilot next week. Quick list of asks so we can scope: SSO (SAML) test IdP, pilot pricing for ~10k req/day, data residency in us-east, security questionnaire deadline Tue, and a joint runbook / ops contact. Looping @Maya R.
Maya R: Thanks Carla — great. Looping Samir (pricing/solutions) and Jordan (infra). We can host the pilot in us-east. For SSO we support SAML/OIDC; easiest for POC is API key + optional SAML test.
Samir K: I can do a quick pricing estimate. Rough calc: 10k req/day * 30 = 300k requests/month. If avg payload ~120 tokens and batching reduces token cost ~20% -> rough pilot: $6k-$12k/mo depending on reserved vs hosted. Will send a detailed table by EOD. link: https://redwood.ai/pilot-estimator (draft)
Jordan L: For infra/setup — two options: hosted API (fast) or Dedicated POC (reserved GPUs) if they need isolation. For SAML test we can spin up a test SP and give EdgeCo test metadata. Quick example command for POC tenant creation:
```
redwoodctl tenant create --name edgeco-poc --region us-east-1 --auth saml --sp-metadata /tmp/sp-metadata.xml
```
We can also provide a temp API key for integration testing first.
Evan G: Security heads-up: we can complete the questionnaire but need answers on data flow (does EdgeCo send any PII?), retention / deletion expectations, and whether they require KMS/HSM integration. Also confirm whether the pilot requires SOC2/ISO artifacts in advance.
Carla P - EdgeCo: EdgeCo will share PII inventory by EOD Monday. NDA was signed last week (I uploaded it to the portal). For the pilot they just need SSO + residency; no KMS for POC.
Maya R: Perfect. Action items: Samir -> send pricing table + two packaging options (hosted pilot, reserved burst). Jordan -> temp tenant + API key + SAML SP metadata by Tue AM. Evan -> create sec questionnaire task and list any docs we need from EdgeCo. I'll own coordination and runbook.
Samir K: Draft pricing sent to Maya; will copy Carla after internal review. Two rows: hosted usage and dedicated reserved (month commit). Example estimate attached in thread (spreadsheet).
sec-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood.ai/sec-queue/EDGECO-2026-03  (assigned to Evan G). Deadline set: 2026-03-24.
Evan G: Noted — will request audit artifacts if needed. Also asking SRE for audit log retention details.
Carla P - EdgeCo: Thanks all. Tue 10am PT for the setup call works for our infra lead. Can Jordan share a calendar invite?
Jordan L: Sending invite now to attendees. I'll include runbook draft and a short checklist: - temp API key + creds - SAML SP metadata - sample curl test - contact list.
Maya R: Great, marking this as priority. Samir/ Evan / Jordan — please flag any enterprise blockers ASAP so we don't slip. :thumbsup:
Carla P - EdgeCo: One last Q on pricing — for the reserved option, can we do a 6-week pilot instead of 1 month? need to confirm budget cycle.
Samir K: Yes, we can pro-rate reserved commitments. I'll include a 6-week pro-rata line in the pricing email.
Maya R: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after the call and update the joint runbook.
Carla P - EdgeCo: Appreciated.
Jordan L: Done — invite sent and runbook draft uploaded to the shared folder: https://redwood.ai/partnerships/edgeco/poc-runbook (permissions: edgeco@edgeco.com + redwood team).
Evan G: Security questionnaire link posted in the runbook so EdgeCo can start filling required fields.
Samir K: Pricing email queued to send after internal approval (should land in Carla's inbox within 2 hours).
Carla P - EdgeCo: Got it — I'll start the PII inventory and share the SAML IdP metadata. Thanks team! :rocket:
